mapping_basis: Paper names the neurons 'Moonwalker' (MDN = moonwalker descending neuron); synonyms.csv maps MDN to the single MANC type MDN; driver VT50660 is the AD hemidriver of the kit's MDN-1 split line.
n_flies_note: not visible on reachable pages (figure legend and methods paywalled)
notes: Paywalled; only figure images, figure titles and supplementary video legends reachable. Backward walking coded yes for all leg pairs per convention. Fig. 2c bottom panel also shows Moonwalker>CsChrimson (635 nm, 45-460 uW) giving negative forward velocity (same outcome, so not a separate record per PROTOCOL 1). Lower TrpA1 powers (58 mW) and 635 nm light on TrpA1 flies show little/no reversal. effect_on_walking left not_assessed because reversal of direction is not in the vocabulary (forward velocity drops below zero). Supplementary PDF (MOESM210) downloaded but could not be rendered/read.
penetrance: Fig. 2c: mean forward velocity becomes negative during/after stimulation vs GAL4 and UAS controls (P < 0.01); dose-dependent with laser power
quote: Thermogenetic activation of moonwalker neurons induces backwards walking. Genotype was VT50660-Gal4; UAS-TrpA1.
source_locator: Supplementary Video 'Activating Moonwalker neurons with TrpA1' (41592_2014_BFnmeth2973_MOESM214_ESM.mp4) legend; Fig. 2c (top and middle panels)
stimulation: FlyMAD 808 nm IR laser targeted to freely walking fly, 208 mW (strongest of 58-208 mW tested), stimulus period ~2 s as shaded in Fig. 2c
title: FlyMAD: rapid thermogenetic control of neuronal activity in freely walking Drosophila
